symbols.name: indeterminate
symbols.meaning: A formal variable, not a number, of the polynomial rings $\mathcal{Q}_1$ and $\mathcal{Q}_3$.
symbols.quote: An indeterminate $\mathcal{X}$ is a formal variable, not a number.

symbols.name: quotient ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of complex polynomials in $\mathcal{X}$ modulo $\mathcal{X}^2-1$.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{Q}_1=\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{X}]/(\mathcal{X}^2-1)$, the quotient ring of complex polynomials in which every multiple of $\mathcal{X}^2-1$ counts as zero.

symbols.name: substitute
symbols.meaning: An element of a commutative ring with square 1, substituted for $\mathcal{X}$.

symbols.name: second indeterminate
symbols.meaning: A formal variable, the indeterminate of $\mathcal{Q}_2$.

symbols.name: quotient ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of complex polynomials in $\mathcal{Y}$ modulo $\mathcal{Y}^2+1$.

symbols.name: inverse isomorphism
symbols.meaning: The homomorphism $\mathcal{Q}_2\to\mathcal{Q}_1$ that inverts $\mathcal{H}$ in Example 1.

symbols.name: cyclic quotient ring
symbols.meaning: The ring $\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{X}]$ modulo $\mathcal{X}^6-1$, the source of the paper's map.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{Q}_3=\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{X}]/(\mathcal{X}^6-1)$, and let $\mathcal{Z}_1$ and $\mathcal{Z}_2$ be the indeterminates of the cyclic axes of lengths 2 and 3, so the target is $\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{Z}_1,\mathcal{Z}_2]/(\mathcal{Z}_1^2-1,\mathcal{Z}_2^3-1)$.

symbols.name: axis indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of the cyclic axis of length 2 in the target ring.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{Q}_3=\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{X}]/(\mathcal{X}^6-1)$, and let $\mathcal{Z}_1$ and $\mathcal{Z}_2$ be the indeterminates of the cyclic axes of lengths 2 and 3, so the target is $\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{Z}_1,\mathcal{Z}_2]/(\mathcal{Z}_1^2-1,\mathcal{Z}_2^3-1)$.

symbols.name: axis indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of the cyclic axis of length 3 in the target ring.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{Q}_3=\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{X}]/(\mathcal{X}^6-1)$, and let $\mathcal{Z}_1$ and $\mathcal{Z}_2$ be the indeterminates of the cyclic axes of lengths 2 and 3, so the target is $\mathbb{C}[\mathcal{Z}_1,\mathcal{Z}_2]/(\mathcal{Z}_1^2-1,\mathcal{Z}_2^3-1)$.
